# data.yaml Schema

Complete schema for the generated design system file.

---

## File Location

```
design-system/data.yaml
```

---

## Complete Schema

```yaml
# Design System
# Generated by: /designsetup
# Source: {site}
# Style: {style}

meta:
  generated_at: "2026-02-03T15:30:00Z"
  source_site: "airbnb"
  style: "Modern SaaS"
  theme: "Travel & Adventure"

psychology:
  style_classification: "Modern SaaS"

  emotions_evoked:
    - emotion: "Trust"
      reason: "Clean typography and ample whitespace"
    - emotion: "Excitement"
      reason: "Vibrant accent colors"

  target_audience:
    primary:
      description: "Young professionals"
      age_range: "25-40"
      tech_savvy: "high"
    secondary:
      description: "Families"
      age_range: "30-50"

  visual_principles:
    - name: "Hierarchy"
      description: "Clear visual hierarchy"
    - name: "Whitespace"
      description: "Generous padding"

  why_it_works:
    - "Large hero images create emotional connection"
    - "Simple navigation reduces cognitive load"

  design_philosophy:
    core_belief: "Design should feel human"
    key_principles:
      - "Simplicity over complexity"
      - "Content-first approach"

style:
  detected: "Modern SaaS"
  characteristics:
    - "Clean lines"
    - "Soft shadows"
    - "Rounded corners"
  feel: "Professional yet approachable"

colors:
  primary:
    DEFAULT: "#FF5A5F"
    foreground: "#ffffff"
    hover: "#E04E52"
  secondary:
    DEFAULT: "#00A699"
    foreground: "#ffffff"
    hover: "#008F84"
  background:
    DEFAULT: "#ffffff"
    muted: "#f1f5f9"
    subtle: "#f8fafc"
  foreground:
    DEFAULT: "#0a0a0a"
    muted: "#64748b"
    subtle: "#94a3b8"
  accent:
    DEFAULT: "#f97316"
    foreground: "#ffffff"
  semantic:
    success: "#10b981"
    warning: "#f59e0b"
    error: "#ef4444"
    info: "#3b82f6"

typography:
  font_family:
    sans: "'Inter', sans-serif"
    heading: "'Inter', sans-serif"
    mono: "'Fira Code', monospace"
  weights:
    - "400"
    - "500"
    - "600"
    - "700"
  sizes:
    xs: "12px"
    sm: "14px"
    base: "16px"
    lg: "18px"
    xl: "20px"
    2xl: "24px"
    3xl: "30px"
    4xl: "36px"
    5xl: "48px"

spacing:
  base: "8px"
  scale:
    - 4
    - 8
    - 12
    - 16
    - 24
    - 32
    - 48
    - 64
    - 96

border_radius:
  sm: "4px"
  md: "8px"
  lg: "12px"
  full: "9999px"

shadows:
  sm: "0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)"
  md: "0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)"
  lg: "0 10px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)"

animations:
  durations:
    fast: "150ms"
    normal: "200ms"
    slow: "300ms"
  easing:
    default: "ease-in-out"
    bounce: "cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)"
  component_animations:
    button_hover: "scale + shadow"
    card_hover: "translateY + shadow"
  scroll_animations:
    enabled: true
    patterns:
      - "fade-in"
      - "parallax"
      - "stacking-cards"

theme:
  name: "Travel & Adventure"
  decorative_elements:
    - "world maps"
    - "compass icons"
    - "destination pins"
  avoid_elements:
    - "corporate icons"
    - "generic stock photos"
```

---

## Section Descriptions

| Section | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `meta` | File metadata (generated date, source) |
| `psychology` | UX/UI psychology analysis from extraction |
| `style` | Design style classification |
| `colors` | Color tokens with variants |
| `typography` | Font families, weights, sizes |
| `spacing` | Grid system and scale |
| `border_radius` | Radius values |
| `shadows` | Shadow levels |
| `animations` | Animation settings |
| `theme` | Decorative direction |

---

## Usage by Agents

```markdown
# In agent workflow

## STEP 0.5: Load Design System

Read: design-system/data.yaml

Extract:
- colors.primary.DEFAULT → For buttons, links
- typography.font_family.sans → For all text
- spacing.scale → For padding/margin values
- animations.durations → For transitions
- theme.decorative_elements → For landing pages
```
